correctness.rationale: The Nyström complement has covariance equal to (A_{UU})^{-1}; Jacobi gives det(K_SS)=det(A_UU)/det A. Exact tail and interior continuants yield a determinant ratio strict chain H_a/H_{a-1}<exp(theta)<F_{j+1}/F_j and strict concavity for interior log determinants. For mu>=1/2, exact increment inequalities g(a)-g(a-1)>=c>f(j)-f(j-1) remove every tail, while strict convexity of x coth(theta*x) balances interiors. For mu<1/2, g(1)<c and the interior increments converge to c, so on some finite path endpoint removal improves trace error. Exact code independently checks 33437 rational assertions; this finite evidence supports but does not replace the analytic all-n proof.

value.rationale: The exact universal half-screening boundary distinguishes entropy-optimal and trace-optimal covariance landmark selection, not merely the existence of a good heuristic. It is nontrivial because endpoint Schur blocks differ from interior blocks and equality classification holds simultaneously for every finite n and k>=2; a 6-node exact rational witness and a general lower-screening existence argument show the threshold is best possible. The classification supplies an interpretable design rule and an exact benchmark for structured covariance approximation, while not claiming improvement over direct tridiagonal solvers.
